lines.en: label chikafirsthall:
scene chikahall1
: Whaaaaaat? No friggin’ way! This can't be happening!
lines.zh: : 什——么？不会吧！这不可能！

lines.en: : Hey Chika. What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Chika。怎么了？

lines.en: scene chikahall2
: This can't be happening!
lines.zh: : 这不可能！

lines.en: : I heard that much. What can't be happening, exactly?
lines.zh: : 这我听见了。到底是什么不可能？

lines.en: : So, this girl I work with at the mall just got a new puppy, and she taught it friggin' math!
lines.zh: : 就是，我在商场一起打工的那个女生，她刚养了只小狗，还教它学数学耶！

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: scene chikahall3
: I don't know, Sensei! Can't you at least be happy for her, though? This is like, a totally huge deal!
lines.zh: : 我也不知道啊，Sensei！但你好歹替她高兴一下吧？这可是超级大事哎！

lines.en: : Happy for your friend? Or happy for the dog?
lines.zh: : 替你朋友高兴？还是替那只狗高兴？

lines.en: : The dog, obviously!
lines.zh: : 当然是狗啊！

lines.en: : Like, my friend is the one who posted the video online and it's gotten her like a trillion new followers, but the dog is the real hero here! We all know that!
lines.zh: : 你看，视频是我朋友发到网上的，给她涨了好像一万亿个粉丝，但那只狗才是真正的英雄！大家都知道的！

lines.en: : Here! Look for yourself. You aren't impressed enough.
lines.zh: : 给！你自己看。你刚才一点都不震撼。

lines.en: scene chikahall4
Chika hands me her phone and, sure enough, there is a video of a dog doing math.
lines.zh: Chika 把手机递给我，果然，屏幕里是一只狗在做数学题的视频。

lines.en: : That dog is going places, Sensei. It's even better at math than Ami.
lines.zh: : 那只狗前途无量啊，Sensei。它数学比 Ami 还厉害呢。

lines.en: : I...don't really understand what I'm watching here.
lines.zh: : 我……不太明白我在看什么。

lines.en: : What's not to understand? My friend asks the dog a basic math problem and then it just barks the correct amount of times.
lines.zh: : 有什么不明白的？我朋友问狗一道基础数学题，然后它就汪正确的次数。

lines.en: : I guess what I'm really not understanding is why someone would waste their time teaching something like that to an animal.
lines.zh: : 我想我真正不明白的是，为什么有人会浪费时间教一只动物这种东西。

lines.en: scene chikahall5
: Well...why do you teach people? I'm sure it's probably for the same reason.
lines.zh: : 呃……那你为什么教人呢？我猜大概是一样的道理吧。

lines.en: : Your friend was reborn into a world where she was already teaching?
lines.zh: : 你朋友重生到一个她已经在当老师的世界了？

lines.en: : I don't know, maybe. If Kanye West can win 23 Grammys, pretty much anything is possible.
lines.zh: : 不知道哎，也许吧。Kanye West 都能拿 23 座格莱美，那什么都有可能。

lines.en: : Wait, what are you even doing over here? I didn't think boys were allowed in the girls' dorm.
lines.zh: : 等等，你在这儿干嘛？男生不是不能进女生宿舍吗？

lines.en: : I'm a special exception to that rule.
lines.zh: : 我是那条规矩的特例。

lines.en: : Is it because Ami lives here? Are you here to teach her math?
lines.zh: : 是因为 Ami 住这儿吗？你是来教她数学的？

lines.en: : Should I call my friend's dog?
lines.zh: : 要不我叫我朋友那只狗来？

lines.en: : I'd rather spend my time exclusively with humans, personally.
lines.zh: : 就我个人而言，我更愿意只跟人类待在一起。

lines.en: scene chikahall6
: Well, I'm a human! You can hang out with me! It's obviously not like I have anything else planned if I'm out in the hall watching TikTok.
lines.zh: : 那我就是人类啊！你可以跟我玩！反正我都站在走廊刷 TikTok 了，显然也没别的事可做。

lines.en: : Well, I guess that's that then. But I'd kind of prefer to go into your room instead of staying out here where everyone else can hear us...talk about dogs or something.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那就这么定了。不过我有点想去你房间，不想待在走廊上让别人都听见我们……聊狗什么的。

lines.en: scene chikahall7
: I mean...I don’t have a problem with that...but I’m pretty sure Yumi would literally kill me if I ever let you see where she sleeps.
lines.zh: : 我倒……不介意啦……但我敢肯定，要是让 Yumi 知道你看到她睡觉的地方，她会杀了我的。

lines.en: : Yumi seems like the type of person to kill you for even talking to me, so I'm glad you're at least doing that much.
lines.zh: : Yumi 看起来是那种你连跟我说话都会杀了你的人，所以我很高兴你至少还敢跟我说话。

lines.en: scene chikahall8
: Yeah...she's really got it out for you for some reason.
lines.zh: : 是啊……她不知道为啥特别针对你。

lines.en: : I guess even she accepts that I can't just not talk to my teacher, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我想她也明白，我总不能不跟自己的老师说话吧。

lines.en: : So, if we can’t go inside, what do you want to do?
lines.zh: : 那，既然进不去，你想干嘛？

lines.en: scene chikahall6
: Oh! I know! How about you tell me a little more about yourself?
lines.zh: : 哦！有了！要不你多跟我讲讲你自己的事？

lines.en: : If we're gonna be doing that whole...informal teaching thing or whatever it was, shouldn't we like, know more about each other?
lines.zh: : 既然我们要搞那个……非正式教学还是啥的，我们是不是该多了解了解彼此？

lines.en: : Well, what do you want to know, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那你想知道什么？

lines.en: : I don't know. Anything, really. Like...what are you good at? What are your interests?
lines.zh: : 不知道哎。什么都行。比如……你擅长什么？有什么爱好？

lines.en: You know...I'm not really sure.
lines.zh: 说起来……我其实不太确定。

lines.en: I haven't really had time to get reacquainted with who I am yet, but...
lines.zh: 我还没来得及重新认识一下自己，不过……

lines.en: : I think...
lines.zh: : 我想……

lines.en: : I think I've always been good at...writing?
lines.zh: : 我想我一直挺擅长……写作的？

lines.en: scene chikahall9
: A writer? Color me impressed.
lines.zh: : 作家？让我刮目相看啊。

lines.en: : What kind of stuff do you write?
lines.zh: : 你都写些什么？

lines.en: : Nothing anymore. But I feel like-
lines.zh: : 现在不写了。但我觉得——

lines.en: scene whygodwhy
scene chikahall9
: Nothing anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在不写了。

lines.en: scene chikahall6
: Well, if you ever start up again, maybe you could show me something?
lines.zh: : 那，要是你以后又写了，可以给我看看吗？

lines.en: : I'll...keep that in mind...
lines.zh: : 我会……记在心上……

lines.en: scene chikahall9
: You okay, Sensei? You look kinda pale all of a-
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Sensei？你脸色突然有点发——

lines.en: scene chikahall10
: Chika? The fuck are you doing out there? You're bein' loud as shit.
lines.zh: : Chika？你他妈在外面干嘛？吵死了。

lines.en: : This about that fuckin' smart dog or whatever again? How many times are you gonna watch that shit?
lines.zh: : 又他妈是那只聪明狗还是啥的？那玩意儿你到底还要看几遍？

lines.en: scene chikahall11
: As many as it takes, Yumi! He's a good boy and you know it!
lines.zh: : 看多少遍都不够，Yumi！它是只好狗狗，你知道的！

lines.en: : Just keep it the fuck down, please. I'm tryin' to sleep.
lines.zh: : 拜托你他妈小声点。我要睡觉。

lines.en: scene chikahall8
: Sorry, Sensei. I should...probably be heading back in now anyway.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sensei。我……反正也该回去了。

lines.en: : But we should definitely do this again sometime.
lines.zh: : 但我们下次一定要再这样聊。

lines.en: : Sounds good to me.
lines.zh: : 好啊。

lines.en: : Just make sure you don't mention that I was here when you head back in or we might never be able to see each other again.
lines.zh: : 你回去可别提我来过这儿，不然我们可能再也见不了面了。

lines.en: scene chikahall12
: My lips are sealed~
lines.zh: : 我嘴巴可严了～

lines.en: scene black
Chika vanishes back into her dorm room and I’m left with nothing to do once again.
lines.zh: Chika 溜回了她的宿舍房间，我又一次无所事事。

lines.en: I guess I’ll just go home and hang out with Ami or something...
lines.zh: 我想我还是回家找 Ami 玩玩吧……

lines.zh: Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！
